name: PAY_RUN_TYPES_F
description: The different types of Payroll Run processing

columns.name: RUN_TYPE_ID
columns.description: System-generated primary key column.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: BASE_RUN_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: BASE_RUN_TYPE_NAME

columns.name: RUN_METHOD
columns.description: Run type category, either 'Normal', 'Separate Payment','Process Separately' or 'Cumulative'.

columns.name: LEGISLATIVE_DATA_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to PER_LEGISLATIVE_DATA_GROUPS.

columns.name: LEGISLATION_CODE
columns.description: Foreign key to FND_TERRITORIES.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to PER_ENTERPRISES.

columns.name: SHORTNAME
columns.description: A shortname or label for the run type.

columns.name: SRS_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if a run type can be used in Standard Report Submission

columns.name: TRANSIENT_FLAG
columns.description: This indicates that the Run Type is temporary and should not conribute to any balances.

columns.name: ELEMENT_RECOVER_FLAG
columns.description: This indicates that the Run Results need to have recovery Elements created in the current period Earning period.

columns.name: COSTING_FLAG
columns.description: This indicates whether this Run Types results should be included in a Costing.

columns.name: RETROPAY_FLAG
columns.description: This indicates whether any Run, Quickpay or Element Rcovery entries can be used in a Retropay.

columns.name: RETRO_INTERLOCK
columns.description: This indicates a special type of Run that interlocks the Retropay

columns.name: OVERRIDE_SHORTNAME
columns.description: This is the Override Short Name, this name will be used in the standard DBIs if populated.

columns.name: INCLUSION_FLAG
columns.description: INCLUSION_FLAG

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SGUID
columns.description: The seed global unique identifier. Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
